message.subject: Collaborating on EdTech resources with EDXSO
message.email_body: Your focus on EdTech and saving teacher time is highly relevant to today's classrooms. Your video titled Teacher Prompt Treasure: Ready-to-Use Ideas in Minutes highlights the potential of AI tools for lesson planning. At EDXSO, we work with schools on academic outcomes, and we want to propose an exploratory co-created educational resource about practical technology in schools. This offers teachers and school leaders concrete benefits. You would develop useful content with our consulting team. Would you be open to a brief conversation?
